neighbours.label: the verb 'restore' (restored, restoring, restore), as against synonyms such as repaired, renovated or rebuilt in the same sentences

Doctors hope the surgery will restore some vision in her left eye.

The charity is restoring wetlands along the northern coast.
A beautifully restored farmhouse sits at the end of the lane.
The new manager promised to restore trust among the staff.
Volunteers spent the summer restoring a steam locomotive.
